checks.name: source_offline_cli_and_prior_completed_replays
command:
import io,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from itov.cli import main
from itov.comfyui import ComfyUIClient
from itov.catalog import sha256
from itov.config import load_config
config=load_config(Path('workspace/itov.toml'))
e=json.loads(Path('docs/evidence/stage-10-offline-20260921.json').read_bytes())
assert e['passed']
def forbidden(*args,**kwargs): raise AssertionError('Offline CLI attempted runtime HTTP')
ComfyUIClient._json=forbidden
def check(command,expected=0):
    out=io.StringIO()
    with redirect_stdout(out): code=main(command)
    assert code==expected,(command,code,out.getvalue())
    result=json.loads(out.getvalue())
    if 'report_id' in result:
        assert result['ok']==(expected==0)
        print(command[:2],result['report_id'],result['normalization'],result['counts'])
    else: print(command[:2],'completed offline replay')
    return result
check(['trigger','lint','examples/trigger.rules.json','--json'])
for kind in ('image','audio'):
    plan=e['plans'][kind]['path']
    check(['trigger','lint','examples/trigger.rules.json','--plan',plan,'--json'])
    first=check(['scene','lint',f'examples/neutral-{kind}.scene.json','--plan',plan,'--save','--json'])
    again=check(['scene','lint',f'examples/neutral-{kind}.scene.json','--plan',plan,'--save','--json'])
    assert first==again
    assert first['findings']==e['reports'][kind+'_scene']['findings']
failed=check(['scene','lint',e['rejected_constraints_path'],'--plan',e['plans']['image']['path'],'--json'],1)
assert failed['findings']==e['reports']['rejected_scene']['findings']
for name,command,key,extra in [
    ('stage-09b-parallel-20260921.json','parallel','plan_path',[]),
    ('stage-09-admission-20260921.json','batch','guarded_plan_path',['--config','workspace/itov-vram.toml']),
    ('stage-08-audio-20260921.json','batch','plan_path',[]),
    ('stage-07-video-20260921.json','batch','plan_path',[]),
]:
    prior=json.loads((Path('docs/evidence')/name).read_bytes())
    check([command,'resume',prior[key],*extra,'--json'])
assert all(sha256((config.root/p).read_bytes())==digest for p,digest in e['preserved_file_sha256'].items())
print('Passed actual offline CLI policies and prior completed replays; zero HTTP; preserved 146 prior files')
